# Schema validation gate for LLM outputs

The system enforces a strict JSON schema (SCHEMA) that disallows additional properties on objects and uses Pydantic (ExtractionOut) to reject malformed or extra fields. Validation failures raise ValidationError, preventing invalid LLM outputs from being accepted.
